posts.title: Friday consultations now run until 21:00
posts.excerpt: From this Friday our evening consultations run until 21:00, so one more evening of the week is open to people who finish work late.
posts.content:
From this Friday our evening consultations run until 21:00. Evening consultations now run Tuesday to Friday, 17:30 to 21:00, so one more late evening is open to people who finish work after the usual hours.

Night studies keep their usual days, Tuesday to Thursday, with check-in at 20:30. To book a consultation, call (206) 555-0142.
